title: Delivery Charges and Service Radius by Catering Service Level
content:
## Delivery charging basis

The logistics office prints two figures against each service level of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement: the standard delivery charge raised per order, in USD, and the distance from the production kitchen that is served without a special quote, in whole miles.

| Service level | Delivery charge per order | Service radius |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | 18.50 USD | 8 miles |
| Delivered Buffet Account | 32.00 USD | 12 miles |
| Attended Buffet Account | 55.00 USD | 18 miles |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | 95.00 USD | 25 miles |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | 125.00 USD | 15 miles |
| Campus Catering Master Account | 145.00 USD | 35 miles |

### Basis notes

The delivery charge is a per-order figure, not a per-mile one: an address one mile from the kitchen and an address at the outer edge of the radius carry the same charge for the same service level. The radius is measured from the production kitchen that serves the site.

The two columns do not move together. The Executive Hospitality Catering Account carries the second highest delivery charge in the schedule at 125.00 USD against the second shortest radius of 15 miles, while the Campus Catering Master Account reaches 35 miles for 145.00 USD.
